'''Veedaaz Awmetth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual<ref name="DB" /> of a [[Unidentified Sarrish species|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="swi102" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HM">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref> [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]]<ref name="swi102" /> who represented the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="DB" /> He had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and red skin with white [[Tattoo/Legends|facial markings]] on his brows, cheeks, and chin.<ref name="SWI74" /> After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Awmetth was among the mourners at the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] for<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="ROTSVD" /> with whom he had worked closely.<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], which took place in Naboo's<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CSWE Theed">{{CSWECite|III|235|Theed}}</ref> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="ROTS" /> Awmetth wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Sarrish Defense Force]] [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]].<ref name="ROTSVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veedaaz Awmetth was created for<ref name="SWI74" /> [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="ROTS" /> The character's appearance originated with a [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] design made by the film's Creature Shop Creative Supervisor [[Dave Elsey]]. After<ref name="SWI74" /> Director<ref name="SWCTP" /> [[George Lucas]] approved a design for Sidious he wanted, the mask was repainted and repurposed for the Senator, at that point still unnamed.<ref name="SWI74" /> The character was first alluded to by the "Crew Cameos" entry in the [[Episode III Set Diary]] written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="Crew Cameos">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030916.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Crew Cameos}}</ref> Awmetth was then first pictured in the "[[Prequel Update]]" portion of the [[Star Wars Insider 74|seventy-fourth edition]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', written by [[Jane Irene Kelly]]<ref name="SWI74" /> and released on [[February 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWI74 release date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2004/01/news20040126.html|text=Clone Trooper Front and Center in ''Insider'' #74}}</ref> Awmetth was later first identified by name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTSVD" /> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]]<ref name="ROTSVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> ahead of the film's release on [[May 19]], 2005.<ref name="Year by Year" /> The character, portrayed by [[Nicholas Ferguson]], was slated to appear in the film,<ref name="SWI74" /> but cannot be seen at any point.<ref name="ROTS" />
